A.title: The Escapement Stair
A.text: The clicking gets louder as you climb. Keep pace with it. Out of time with the stair you fall.

Y.title: Parts Store Ledger
Y.text: Shelves of springs, pins and gears, each labelled in a neat hand. Stock count: thousands. Stock needed: none.

R.title: Under the Pendulum Gallery
R.text: Beneath the floorboards, a stone engraved with a clockmaker's mark. It says: strike when the pendulum is at the top of its swing, for that is when it stops. Wait for the stop, then hit.

G.title: Since the First Clock
G.text: The first clock was wound before the war between the old ages. Its makers are long dead. It has not stopped. The clockmaker's hammer is still on the bench.

M.title: The Mourning Hour
M.text: At dusk the broken clockwork gather here and stand in rows. They do not attack. Stay out of the rows, and they ignore you.

O.title: Brass Wall Mark
O.text: Tap the brass with a coin. A flat sound means a wall. A ringing sound means a hollow behind it. A hunter marked three hollows in chalk.

U.title: The Spur
U.text: A gear with a single long tooth, bent. The Great Mainspring thumps beyond it, slow and heavy. Keep the beat in your ears and you will not get lost.

X.title: Clockmaker's Last Word
X.text: I built the engines to idle until the world needed them. I did not say when. Nobody wound them since the peace. Wind carefully, or the whole thing starts.
